source.subject: viral Claude Code + Binance trading-bot claim

evidence_assessment.copy_pattern_note: Same numbers and architecture copy recur across unrelated accounts with changing follow/DM calls-to-action.
evidence_assessment.conclusion: Do not use claimed returns, win rate, arbitrage profitability or speed-edge assertions in XRAY validation.

adopted_principles.xray_adaptation: Independent providers/phases may read concurrently where provider limits permit; deterministic merge and authority gates remain sequential/fail-closed.
Cheap/batch sources route work; authoritative exact evidence decides PASS/FAIL. Accelerator data never silently becomes alpha authority.
Canonical policy and deterministic lifecycle rules govern research state; no discretionary override or execution.

rejected_principles.reason: XRAY is 2–8 completed-session swing research, not sub-second cross-market arbitrage; latency-arbitrage claims are irrelevant and unverified.
EXECUTION=NONE and REAL_MONEY=NO-GO remain hard invariants.
No independently verifiable evidence; viral-copy pattern creates strong promotional-content risk.

risk_translation_for_xray: Parallelism must respect provider-specific rate limits; observed Longbridge 429002 under parallel fan-out.
Partial data must remain visibly partial; exact set/hash completeness is required.
Any future execution research would need fees, spread, slippage, liquidity, queue position and market-impact modeling; none are inferred from the viral post.
